title: Shipment
description: One parcel: its contents, destination, carrier booking, and current delivery status.

shipment-id.description: Identity of this parcel, stable from creation to final state.

order-id.description: Order being fulfilled. Not unique here — one order may split into several shipments.

parcel-index.description: Position of this parcel within its order's split, stamped once and never renumbered. Gaps are legal — a rebooked parcel keeps the number the customer was told.

parcel-count.description: How many parcels the order was split into at the moment of splitting. Absent means the split was not recorded, not that there is one parcel.

lines.description: The subset of the order's lines travelling in this parcel, in shop's own line model.

destination.description: Where the parcel is going. Blanked in place on erasure; the shipment itself survives.

status.description: Projection of the carrier-booking conversation state. The state machine is normative.

carrier.description: Carrier that accepted the booking, as the gateway names it. Absent until one has.

service-level.description: Normalized service class. Carrier product names are mapped onto this by the gateway.

tracking-number.description: Carrier's own reference. Opaque to acme and unique only within that carrier.

shipping-cost.description: What the accepted carrier quote actually cost, including surcharges.

weight-grams.description: Gross weight as measured at dispatch. Carriers price on it, so it is not an estimate.

promised-delivery-at.description: Date the customer was told, taken from the accepted quote and never recomputed.

booked-at.description: When a carrier accepted this parcel. Absent while status is requested or failed.

signed-for-by.description: Name written on the courier's device at handover. Present only for signature-required service, blanked in place on erasure, never matched against an account.

delivered-at.description: When the courier recorded the handover. The scan time, not the time acme learned of it.
